Chapter 6903: A Mortal

Chapter 6903: A Mortal

Stygian’s grand momentum could absorb the essences of its dead members, boosting the staff of authority as a whole.

The unity required the members’ acceptance first; this was the outcome Guangmai desired.

“Ugh...” When the divine intent returned to his body, he spat out a mouthful of blood and immediately began the recovery process.

“What was that?” The immortals became startled.

“Was it the illumination or the power of the world’s heart?” The golden immortals couldn’t tell. Even Guangmai didn’t know for certain.

They all saw Li Qiye pushing the world’s heart out and a monstrous power sent Guangmai’s divine intent back to the old headquarters.

The divine intent of a primordial immortal could kill a golden immortal, even when subjected to the illumination. Alas, Guangmai was injured now.

Li Qiye stood up amidst confused gazes and suddenly appeared at the old headquarters.

“Who are you?” Guangmai still only saw a mortal.

“A passerby.” Li Qiye revealed a friendly smile.

Guangmai used his heavenly gaze and saw a mortal from top to bottom. Even a celestial mortal couldn’t hide his cultivation to this level. However, how could a mortal travel in Stygian freely and show no fear before them?

“A passerby?” They exchanged glances of confusion.

“Your power is from the world’s heart?” Guangmai cared about this the most.

Li Qiye smiled and waved his hand.

“Buzz.” The world’s heart flew over and floated above him.

“You tell me.” He said.

“The heart!” Guangmai got up from his chair; his breathing became more rapid.

He has been thinking about how to remove the heart from Golden Lamp. Now, it was right before them.

His eyes blazed intensely, unable to put on a calm act like before. He wanted nothing more than to seize it.

Nevertheless, he glanced at the group, telling them to form a formation around Li Qiye.

“I asked if you are wielding the heart’s power.” He inquired again, as this was the right explanation for a mortal possessing such great power.

“How should I put this? It isn’t difficult for me to wield it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“It is something that can create worlds.” Guangmai said.

“Yes, and more.” Li Qiye nodded.

“What else can it do?” Controller interjected.

Li Qiye touched the heart and said: “Many more uses, depending on what you want to do. Of course, you have to understand how to control it first, then it’ll be even better than a mythical heavenly treasure.”

“Can it cross the ocean and sever karma?” Guangmai couldn’t help but ask the only question on his mind.

“Yes, as long as you can control it.” Li Qiye said with confidence.

Guangmai became increasingly impatient upon hearing this. Controller took note of this and had an unpleasant premonition.

Guangmai took a deep breath and sat back down to heal. Nevertheless, he kept on asking: “The heart can bless Stygian and our alliance, no one will take it away.”

“Yes, it does belong to this world, just not your alliance.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Stygian is under our rule. If it belongs to this world, it belongs to us.” Devouring Lord’s words echoed thunderously.

“Your alliance took over the nest, there was Golden Mortal World before you.” Li Qiye said.

“That’s long in the past.” God Messenger said.

“Let’s not be rude to our guest now.” Guangmai raised his hand and calmed the crowd before speaking to Li Qiye: “Our alliance is very reasonable.”
